facts.fact: The Djibouti Council of Ministers communique of 14 January 2025 approves an ANSIE 2025 budget that includes upkeep of PKI supports, with no service or use described.

The Council of Ministers communique of 14 January 2025 lists strengthening the CERT and launching a cybersecurity strategy among ANSIE's 2025 projects, with 28.5 million FDJ of investment covering cybersecurity among other items.
The Council of Ministers communique of 14 January 2025 names X-Road supports among items in ANSIE's 2025 budget, with no bodies connected or use stated.

DJI.note: The disability action plan item has nothing on information or digital services.

facts.fact: The Council of Ministers communique of 14 January 2025 approves ANSIE's 2025 budget of 556.7 million FDJ, covering its work for administrations on the E-JO and E-BALO platforms, archive digitisation, a human-resources solution and support to the social registry.

DJI.note: Only support to the social registry; no link or exchange stated.

facts.fact: The Council of Ministers communique of 14 January 2025 lists ANSIE support to the social registry among its 2025 projects, with no registry status, programmes or ID link stated.
